description: Capability set for the SLTerm shell. Data access goes through the Go backend over loopback HTTP/WS, so the webview needs no filesystem or shell permissions of its own. What it does need is the window actions its own titlebar performs: core:window:default is getters only, so dragging, minimising, maximising and closing are each granted explicitly. Nothing here lets the page create a webview — a page that could would be able to point one at a URL of its choosing and have the backend auth key injected into it.
